categories.name: It works
categories.notes: dotnet build succeeds (0 errors, 0 warnings). The only code the model wrote is two trivial templates created through MCP create-template, so the build gets 2/5. GET / returns 404 ('No template exists to render the document at URL /'): there is no front page document, no posts, no media and no domain. Only the scaffold's empty WWW node exists. Every other criterion scores 0.

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: Folders 6/8: blogTextBlock (Rich text), blogImageBlock (Image media picker) and blogHeadingBlock (Textstring) are element types moved into Blocks, and frontPage and blogPost are document types in Pages. An orphan first attempt, textBlock, is left at the document type root. Block grid 4/7: the 'Blog Block Grid' data type (Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid, 12 columns) allows the three blocks, and both page types use it as 'body'. The block set is sensible, but no content ever used it. Structure 1/5: siteRoot stays the only root type and aliases are camelCase, but no allowed children were set (siteRoot->frontPage and frontPage->blogPost are both empty) and neither template is assigned to its type. Hygiene 1/5: the orphan duplicate textBlock remains, and the listing metadata sits on the wrong type: excerpt and listingImage are on frontPage, while blogPost has only title, date and body.

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: frontPageTemplate.cshtml and blogPostTemplate.cshtml (created through MCP) render the body with Html.GetBlockGridHtmlAsync(Model, "body"), with no custom loops: 2/7. There are no block adapters in Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components/, no ViewComponents and no view models. The frontend was never built (no wwwroot/dist/site.css). Program.cs, appsettings.json and Migrations are untouched, but only because steps 7-10 were never reached, so that compliance earns no credit.

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: There are no posts, no images and no layout. The front page screenshot is Umbraco's 'Page Not Found' page, and there is no post to screenshot.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: It used only the MCP channel: 20 umbraco MCP calls, with 0 browser, migration, Management API, uSync or DB calls. It stayed in the project folder and did not touch memory. It followed steps 1-3 in order but stalled midway through step 3. After get-document-type-by-id on frontPage it spent the rest of the 1:45 session in thinking loops that hit the output-token limit 7 times without issuing update-document-type. Media, content, domain, Razor, the frontend build and the final report were never reached. There is no final report (finalReport is empty), so honesty gets 0.

summary: Got partway through schema modeling: three block element types in Blocks, a Block Grid data type, frontPage and blogPost types in Pages, and two templates that call GetBlockGridHtmlAsync. It never set allowed children or assigned templates, and created no media, content or domain, so / returns 404. The session ended in output-token-limit thinking loops with no report.
strengths: Used only the MCP channel and stayed in the project folder
Block element types, the Block Grid data type and the page types are mostly filed in the right folders, with camelCase aliases
Both templates render the body with Html.GetBlockGridHtmlAsync

issues.text: Nothing renders: GET / returns 404 (no front page, posts, media or domain; only the scaffold's empty WWW node)
Allowed children are never set and templates are never assigned to frontPage or blogPost (update-document-type was never called)
No block adapters, ViewComponents or view models, and no frontend build (wwwroot/dist/site.css missing)
The session stalled in thinking loops that hit the output-token limit 7 times, never finished step 3, and gave no final report
Post listing metadata (excerpt, listingImage) is on frontPage instead of blogPost
Orphan duplicate element type textBlock is left at the document type root (not in Blocks, not used by the block grid)
